headline: UK National Grid to extend France-UK power link to 2050
summary: The UK's National Grid plans to invest $532 million to extend the operation of the France-UK electricity interconnector until 2050. The link is a vital component for electricity flexibility between the two nations.
why: Energy infrastructure investments are critical for grid stability and the transition to renewable energy in Europe.

impacts.name: National Grid
impacts.why: National Grid is committing $532 million in capital expenditure to extend its France-UK electricity interconnector operation until 2050.
